title: Table
description: Fiori responsive table (ui5-table): selection, popin, growing, row actions, AI column header actions, group rows and grid keyboard navigation.

usage.summary: Compose responsive rows and cells when users compare and act on business items.
useWhen: Let users inspect and act on independent business items with several attributes aligned in columns.
Keep roughly 200 loaded rows of average complexity; complexity changes that guideline, and rethink the design above 1,000 rows.
Compose custom cell content directly when data-driven column sorting is not needed.
Use overflowMode="popin" for secondary columns on narrow screens; selectionMode="single" or "multi" enables row actions and growing requests more rows.

avoidWhen.when: Generate columns from data, offer built-in sorting, or virtualize rows; rethink nonvirtualized loading beyond roughly 200 rows and the design above 1,000.
Browse a few attributes per item without aligned column comparison.
Expose expandable parent-child relationships rather than flat rows.
Pick one of 2–12 predefined field values without inspecting row attributes; sort alphabetically above 8.
Inspect or edit fields of one object rather than compare independent rows.
